g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: chr1 in blue; s5, an HG002 allele in place of s3, in orange

g.title: cluster_query
g.text: each node is a row filed under a chr1 interval; a query returns the rows it overlaps

g.title: cluster_drawn
g.text: the blue line traces chr1's path, and yellow marks chr1:25-30 on s3
s2 and s4, pale, lie outside the query: the links of s3 and s5 bring them in

g.title: hits
g.text: s5 lies off chr1, so the tool files it under the span it hangs from, chr1:10-40.
The tool files each link in graph.links.bed.gz under the span its two nodes cover.
